mapper.select:
SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.pc.ApiCertKeyMapper.select.selectSubCertKeyListCnt - 구독 건수조회 */ COUNT(*) FROM USCM.TBCM_PRDSBSC_L A LEFT JOIN USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_M B ON B.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID LEFT JOIN USCM.TBCM_INST_M C ON C.INSTITUTION_CODE = A.INST_USER_INTG_ID
AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.PRDSBSC_STTS_CD IN ('A0040001', 'A0040002', 'A0040004')
AND B.SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD = #{saasPrdctPvsnMthSeCd}
AND B.SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD = #{saasPrdctTypeCd}
AND B.SAAS_PRDCT_NM LIKE '%' || #{saasPrdctNm} || '%'
AND C.INSTITUTION_NAME LIKE '%' || #{institutionName} || '%'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USCM.TBCM_PRDSBSC_CERT_L D WHERE D.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID AND D.INST_USER_INTG_ID = A.INST_USER_INTG_ID )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USCM.TBCM_PRDSBSC_CERT_L E WHERE E.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID AND E.INST_USER_INTG_ID = A.INST_USER_INTG_ID )

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.pc.ApiCertKeyMapper.select.selectApiCertKeyDetail - 통신테스트 상세 조회 */ A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID AS SAAS_PRDCT_ID /* 상품ID */ , USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD) as SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD_NM /* 상품구분명 */ , USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD) as SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD_NM /* 상품유형명 */ , B.SAAS_PRDCT_NM AS SAAS_PRDCT_NM /* 상품명 */ , NULL AS INSTITUTION_NAME /* 구독기관명(통신테스트인증은 없음) */ , A.SRVR_SE_CD AS SRVR_SE_CD /* 서버구분코드 */ , USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(SRVR_SE_CD) as SRVR_SE_CD_NM /* 서버구분명 */ , A.FRST_CRT_PRCR_ID AS FRST_CRT_PRCR_ID , A.LAST_CHG_PRCR_ID AS LAST_CHG_PRCR_ID FROM USCM.TBCM_CMNC_MNG_L A LEFT JOIN USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_M B ON A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = B.SAAS_PRDCT_ID WHERE A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = #{saasPrdctId} AND A.SRVR_SE_CD = #{srvrSeCd}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.pc.ApiCertKeyMapper.select.selectApiCertInfoList - 통신테스트 인증키정보 조회 */ SAAS_PRDCT_ID /* 상품ID */ , SRVR_SE_CD /* 서버구분코드 */ , CERT_SE_CD /* 인증구분코드 */ , CMNC_CERT_SN /* 시험인증일련번호 */ , AUTHKEY_NM /* 인증키명 */ , AUTHKEY /* 인증키값 */ , FRST_CRT_PRCR_ID , FRST_CRT_DT , LAST_CHG_PRCR_ID , LAST_CHG_DT FROM USCM.TBCM_CMNC_CERT_L WHERE SAAS_PRDCT_ID = #{saasPrdctId} AND SRVR_SE_CD = #{srvrSeCd}
AND CERT_SE_CD = #{certSeCd}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.pc.ApiCertKeyMapper.select.selectSubCertKeyDetail - 구독 상세 조회 */ A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID AS SAAS_PRDCT_ID /* 상품ID */ , A.PRDSBSC_SN AS PRDSBSC_SN /* 구독일련번호 */ , B.SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD AS SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD /* 상품구분코드 */ , USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD) as SAAS_PRDCT_PVSN_MTH_SE_CD_NM /* 상품구분명 */ , B.SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD AS SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD /* 상품유형코드 */ , USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD) as SAAS_PRDCT_TYPE_CD_NM /* 상품유형명 */ , B.SAAS_PRDCT_NM AS SAAS_PRDCT_NM /* 상품명 */ , A.INST_USER_INTG_ID AS INST_USER_INTG_ID /* 기관사용자통합아이디 */ , A.INST_USER_SE_CD AS INST_USER_SE_CD /* 기관사용자구분코드 */ , USCM.SF_COMM_CD_NM(INST_USER_SE_CD) AS INST_USER_SE_CD_NM /* 기관사용자구분명 */ , C.INSTITUTION_NAME AS INSTITUTION_NAME /* 구독기관명 */ FROM USCM.TBCM_PRDSBSC_L A LEFT JOIN USCM.TBCM_SAAS_PRDCT_M B ON B.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID LEFT JOIN USCM.TBCM_INST_M C ON C.INSTITUTION_CODE = A.INST_USER_INTG_ID WHERE A.SAAS_PRDCT_ID = #{saasPrdctId} AND A.INST_USER_INTG_ID = #{instUserIntgId} AND A.INST_USER_SE_CD = #{instUserSeCd} AND A.PRDSBSC_SN = #{prdsbscSn}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: ci.sc.cm.pc.ApiCertKeyMapper.select.selectSubCertInfoList - 구독 상세 조회 */ SAAS_PRDCT_ID /* 상품ID */ , INST_USER_INTG_ID /* 기관사용자통합아이디 */ , INST_USER_SE_CD /* 기관사용자구분코드 */ , PRDSBSC_SN /* 구독일련번호 */ , PRDSBSC_CERT_SN /* 구독인증일련번호 */ , AUTHKEY_NM /* 인증키명 */ , AUTHKEY /* 인증키값 */ , FRST_CRT_PRCR_ID , FRST_CRT_DT , LAST_CHG_PRCR_ID , LAST_CHG_DT FROM USCM.TBCM_PRDSBSC_CERT_L WHERE SAAS_PRDCT_ID = #{saasPrdctId} AND INST_USER_INTG_ID = #{instUserIntgId} AND INST_USER_SE_CD = #{instUserSeCd}
